newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air signs S. American freight pacts.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air signs S. American freight pacts.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc said it signed agreements with two South American carriers to provide two Boeing Co 747-200 freighter aircraft.
The first three-year contract, which will begin this quarter, is with an existing South American customer that did not want to be identified, Atlas said.
The second three-year contract is with a consortium of airlines led by the Colombian carrier LAS. The agreement will begin immediately.
Atlas Air is a U.S.-certificated air carrier that operates a fleet of 747 freighters under long-term contracts that include the provision by Atlas of aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance.
